text.title: Saving Water in the Village
body: Amina lives in a small village in the south of Algeria.
Every summer, the weather is very hot and dry, and water is hard to find.
Last year, the village built a new water tank near the school.
Now, families can collect clean water every morning.
Amina's mother says this has changed their lives.
Before, she had to walk two kilometres to fetch water from a well.
Today, she only walks two hundred metres.
Amina and her friends also learned to save water at school.
They turn off the tap when they brush their teeth, and they use old water to clean the classroom.
Their teacher, Mr Belkacem, says that small habits can make a big difference.
Next month, Amina's class will visit another village to teach children there about saving water.
Amina is very proud of this project.
